claims.text: VPIN follows Easley, Lopez de Prado and O'Hara 2012, Eq. 1: buy and sell volume is sliced into equal-volume buckets and the day's informed-trading probability is the mean absolute buy-sell imbalance across them.

claims.text: A newcomer would not guess the fetch layer knows futures conventions: to pull E-mini depth it resolves each date to the correct front-month contract, rolling to the next quarterly expiry on the Thursday before the third Friday of the expiry month.

claims.text: What this layer does not do is model anything: it stops at cached parquet panels and bar sequences, and away from Goldman's network, where pytickclient and TSDB are unreachable, it can only serve dates the caches under data/raw/ already hold.
